title: AWS Core Concepts
subtitle: These questions are taken/modeled after questions that appear in AWS Cloud Practitioner Exam

questions.prompt: A Japanese company hosts its instances in Tokyo Region. What can the company do to reduce latency for the users in the US while minimizing costs?
options: Applying the Amazon Connect latency-based routing policy.
Registering a new US domain name to serve the users in the US.
Building a new data center in the US and implementing a hybrid model.
Deploying new Amazon EC2 instances in a Region located in the US.

questions.prompt: Your company has a data store application that requires access to a NoSQL database. Which AWS database offering would meet this requirement?
You want to run a questionnaire application for only one day (without interruption), which Amazon EC2 purchase option should you use?
Which statement is true in relation to the security of Amazon EC2?
options: You should use instance store volumes to store login data.
You should regularly patch OS and applications on your EC2 instances
Deploy critical components of your application in an AZ that you trust
You can track all API calls using Amazon Athena

questions.prompt: Who from the following will get the largest discount?
A developer is planning to build a two-tier web application that has a MySQL DB layer. Which AWS DB services would provide automated backups?
options: A MySQL database installed on an EC2 instance

questions.prompt: For storing regular backups, which is the most cost-effective storage option that provides immediate retrieval of your backups?
Which of the following acts as a virtual firewall at the Amazon EC2 instance level to control traffic for one or more instances?
A user is planning to launch two additional Amazon EC2 instances to increase availability. Which launch strategy should the user employ?
options: Spread instances across multiple (AZ) in a single AWS Region
EC2 Reserved Instances in the same AWS Region and the same AZ
Multiple AWS Regions but in the same Availability Zone
EC2 Spot Instances in the same AWS Region but in different AZs

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of having infrastructure hosted in AWS? (Choose TWO)
options: There is no need to worry about security.
Gaining complete control over the physical infrastructure.
Operating applications on behalf of customers.
All physical and most of data/network security are taken care of

questions.prompt: What should you do in order to keep the data on EBS volumes safe? (Choose TWO)
options: Regularly update firmware on EBS devices.
Ensure that EBS data is encrypted at rest.
Store a backup daily in an external drive.
Prevent any unauthorized access to AWS data centers.

questions.prompt: A customer is planning to migrate their Microsoft SQL Server DBs to AWS. Which AWS Services can they use to run their database on AWS? (Choose TWO)
Which of the following common IT tasks can AWS cover to free up company IT resources? (Select TWO.)
